domain_claim: Enriched Span with optional line/column fields maintains backward compatibility: Span::ZERO unchanged, Span::new() sets None, Span::with_location() sets both Some, and the paired invariant holds for all public constructors.
notes: Verify no panic on construction, paired invariant, Located<T>/Spanned<T> unchanged behavior. Kani: bounded proof that with_location panics on invalid input? No — never panics. Proptest: for-all (start,end,line,col) with start<=end, line>=1, col>=1, with_location produces paired Some.

domain_claim: NonEmptyVec<T> invariants: len()>=1 always, is_empty() always false, first() never panics, from_vec(empty) returns None, into_vec() preserves all elements.
notes: Kani: verify from_vec(empty)==None, new(x).first()==x, with_tail(x, tail).len()==1+tail.len(). Proptest: round-trip from_vec → into_vec preserves elements.

domain_claim: Diagnostic with optional source_file field: None for runtime, Some(non-empty) for authored, backward compatible with existing constructors.
notes: Verify Diagnostic::new with Span::ZERO produces source_file: None. Verify source_file: Some(s) implies s is non-empty (test only, not type-enforced).

domain_claim: YamlError variants carrying Option<SourceSpan>: parse-level errors always Some from event stream, limit errors may be None, backward compat with None.
notes: Kani: verify construction with span: None compiles for all variants. Proptest: event-stream errors produce Some(span) equal to the input EventSpan converted to SourceSpan.

domain_claim: canonical_yaml_error() preserves SourceSpan from YamlError into SourceMark on CompileError::CanonicalYaml. When YamlError has span: None, mark is unavailable(). Exhaustive extraction covers all 19 variants.
notes: Kani: for each YamlError variant, verify extract_span yields the correct SourceMark or unavailable(). Verify exhaustiveness: match covers all variants.

domain_claim: ValidationError span propagation: diagnostic_from_error(error) sets Diagnostic.span to error.span. Backward compat: errors with Span::ZERO produce Span::ZERO. Exhaustive match on all ~50 variants.
notes: Kani: for each ValidationError variant with known span, verify diagnostic_from_error produces matching span. Proptest: for-all pairs (error variant, span), diagnostic.span == error.span.

domain_claim: Bridge conversions: From<SourceSpan> for Span (lossy, never panics), From<SourceMark> for Span (respects available flag), From<SourceSpan> for SourceMark (preserves all data). No usize->u32 panic.
notes: Kani: verify for any usize values (including u32::MAX, u32::MAX+1, usize::MAX) that SourceSpan->Span never panics. Miri: no UB in usize->u32 casts. Proptest: round-trip SourceSpan→SourceMark preserves offsets/lines/cols.

domain_claim: Tree validation errors get SourceMarks backfilled from AstMarks lookups (step, nested_key, trigger, document) instead of unavailable(). Graceful degradation when lookup fails.
notes: Kani: verify that when AstMarks has a matching entry, the error's SourceMark.available==true. Proptest: build AstMarks from known YAML, validate against it, assert specific errors have correct line/column.

domain_claim: Dead SourceMap placeholder removed from vb_core. All references migrated or removed. vb_yaml::SourceMap is the canonical type. No compilation errors or dead imports remain.
notes: No formal verification needed — dead code removal. Verify via grep: no SourceMap in vb_core/src. Verify via cargo check: all crates compile.

domain_claim: Single canonical ValidationError→Diagnostic conversion. diag_render.rs is removed or re-exports from diagnostic.rs. No code duplication.
notes: Verification: grep for 'fn diagnostic_from_error' returns exactly one definition. grep for 'fn error_diagnostic_parts' returns exactly one definition. All BDD tests pass.

domain_claim: Diagnostic messages include YAML author path from SemanticSourceMap when available. Path is appended to existing message, not a replacement. Absence of map produces un-annotated message.
notes: Proptest: generate YAML with known paths and errors, verify diagnostic message contains path. Unit test: message without SemanticSourceMap is un-annotated.

domain_claim: All existing tests pass after enrichment. Tests asserting Span::ZERO are updated. Pattern matches with .. compile. moon ci passes.
notes: CI gate: moon ci exit 0. cargo test --workspace exit 0. No test regressions. New tests added for span propagation verify correctness of new behavior. Old tests updated to construct errors with Span::ZERO where zero is expected.
